sqlGroup.select:
select a.* from sys_dict_type a
and a.dname like '%${name}%'
and a.dcode like '%${code}%'
order by a.id desc

select count(1) as cnt from sys_dict_type a where a.dcode=#{dcode}
and a.id <> #{id}

select a.id,a.dname from sys_dict_type a where a.id in
#{tids}
SELECT a.tid, a.dname, a.dval, b.dname AS tname FROM sys_dict a LEFT JOIN sys_dict_type b ON a.tid = b.id WHERE a.tid = #{tid};
